options.name: chassis
options.description: Chassis type of the machine. Written to C(/etc/machine-info).

options.name: deployment
options.description: Deployment environment of the machine, such as V(development) or V(production). Written to C(/etc/machine-info). An empty string removes it from C(/etc/machine-info).

options.name: icon_name
options.description: Icon name of the machine, following the XDG icon naming specification. Written to C(/etc/machine-info). An empty string removes it from C(/etc/machine-info).

options.name: location
options.description: Physical location of the machine, such as a rack or room name. Written to C(/etc/machine-info). An empty string removes it from C(/etc/machine-info).

options.name: pretty_hostname
options.description: Free-form UTF-8 hostname for presentation, such as V(Taylor's Laptop), as C(hostnamectl hostname --pretty) sets. Written to C(/etc/machine-info). An empty string removes it from C(/etc/machine-info).

options.name: static_hostname
options.description: Static hostname written to C(/etc/hostname), as C(hostnamectl hostname --static) sets. C(systemd-hostnamed) applies it as the transient hostname as well, so RV(hostname) follows it. An empty string removes C(/etc/hostname).

options.name: transient_hostname
options.description: Transient hostname, as C(hostnamectl hostname --transient) sets. C(/etc/hostname) takes the highest preference in C(systemd-hostnamed), so a transient hostname cannot take effect while a static one is configured. Nothing is done when RV(hostname) already matches, whatever the source. When it differs and a static hostname is configured, this fails rather than reporting a change it cannot make, so set O(static_hostname) to the same value instead, either on its own or alongside.
